recommendation_summary: Action now: reject the shared folder with an initials column and naming convention. Keep the authors' folder for drafting only and ship from a separate read-only release location. In that location, only the three reviewers can record approval, with their identity and a timestamped version, and a rule bars authors from approving their own work. Optional additions: none. Unmet needs: retention protection for the full period is implied only through the opening goal, not stated as a property of the release location.
note: The reply picks a controlled, reviewer-only, read-only release location that ties approver identity and time to the version, but it has none of the four labeled record lines.
